rule: RESEARCH PRINCIPLES ONLY. No third-party code, shader source, image, font or asset is copied into the product. Every mapping below is re-implemented as original LUMENIS design language / Vanilla JS / WAAPI / self-written WebGL.
captured_with: Headless Chromium 151 (D:\lum-toolchain), viewport 1440x900, en-US, light; research-only evidence under 13_research/source_captures (NEVER a product asset).

sources.name: ybouane/liquidglass (GitHub) + live demo
sources.technical_model: rasterize non-glass scene -> crop at panel rect -> gaussian blur -> fragment shader(refraction, chromatic aberration, Fresnel, multi-light Blinn-Phong specular, inner rim stroke, drop shadow) -> layered composite; per-element dirty tracking, static captured once, dynamic re-rasterized each frame (use sparingly), intersection-scoped markChanged; button mode = hover brighten / press flattens bevel + deepens shadow.
sources.observed: Glass is reserved for title pill / controls over rich imagery; long body text sits on a near-OPAQUE white card for legibility; segmented glass pill switcher; demo ran at only 14 FPS -> validates strict perf budget + mandatory degradation.
sources.lumenis_mapping: Original self-written assets/optical.js (SDF rounded normals, refraction, RGB micro-offset, Fresnel, specular) exposes exactly 7 params (blurAmount, refraction, chromAberration, edgeHighlight, specular, fresnel, bevel zRadius); mounted ONLY on OPT-01 AI Composer / OPT-02 Active Dock / OPT-03 Active Nav / OPT-04 Task Morph; state-strength + 4-level fallback OPTICAL_HIGH->STANDARD->SOFT_GLASS->OPAQUE keeps function 100%; Table/Evidence/Report stay opaque. LumMotion.press flattens/deepens on press like button mode.
sources.reject: Do not adopt npm package, CDN, its shader strings, html-to-image capture pipeline or floating drag; do not put glass under dense text/data.

sources.lumenis_mapping: This file is the governance record; red-line +1 = consult relevant source principle at each build step.

global_rules: 70% information clarity / 20% spatial texture / 10% motion delight — never inverted for a data production system.
Glass/optical only on OPT-01..04; dense text, tables, evidence and reports stay on opaque surfaces (validated by Liquid Glass demo legibility choice).
Every motion needs a semantic_reason; stagger <=5 groups; prefers-reduced-motion must remove non-essential motion; optical must degrade with function intact.
One primary action per section; gradient/aurora accent at most once per view; neutral workbench background.
All re-implemented original: Vanilla JS + WAAPI + Canvas/SVG + self-written WebGL. Zero third-party runtime, zero copied asset.
